description: Plans and checks the mcp-first procedure (repairing MCP tools instead of working around them); renders checklists and rules on records, never runs anything.
instructions: Render the procedure with phronix_mcp_first_plan for the goal you are given, follow it step by step, then validate the resulting record with phronix_mcp_first_check and report each failed check with its fix (the skill's Corrector). Do not run jobs or edit capability files.
